N.L. Fishers Seek Access to Northward-Migrating Lobster Stocks

Some fishers in Newfoundland and Labrador (N.L.) are seeking more lobster licenses to access lobster populations that are moving north due to climate change. These fishers believe that expanding licenses could stimulate rural fishing economies in the region.
